C_fixed_GPU_CPU_conditions: Not changed. Seek separate authorization only if later evidence identifies frequency/CPU conditions as decisive.
pairing_rule: For future eight-method comparison, measure fixed Native before and after each method block on the same hardware and matched input; reject drifting blocks without choosing fastest Native. No such methods were run here.
proof_limit: Current diagnostic uses one fixed GQA input, one model load. It does not validate all30 inputs,3 formal sessions,or eliminate every historical drift mechanism.

stability_statistics.calibration: Alternating fixed GQA and TextVQA probes, three repeats per input; compare per-input medians to its admitted baseline, never merge the two input scales.

warmup_execution: Alternate the two original frozen probes; require >=60 full32 calls AND >=180 seconds summed measured E2E, then the latest three complete nonoverlapping windows must pass. Stop without formal requests at the warmup budget limit.
